1.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
1.comment: Observed that there is not a Certified Food Protection Manager present during the inspection. PICs were notified -- their previous certification recently expired. PICs plan to renew their CFPM. Ensure that the PICs are CFPMs who are always present when food preparation is happening.

2.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
2.comment: There were dirty dishes observed in the basin of the handwashing sink. The dishes were removed and placed inside of the ware washing sink to correct the violation. Ensure that the handwashing sink remains unobstructed to allow easy access for employees to wash hands.

3.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
3.comment: Inspectors observed a gap between the exterior door and door frame so that there was visible daylight along the bottom of the door. PIC was informed and will repair the door or attach a barrier to avoid entry of insects, rodents and other animals.

4.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
4.comment: There were at least two containers of salad dressings that lacked proper date marking inside of the dressing cooler. The items included tartar sauce and chipotle mayonnaise. Discussed with the PIC that in house dressings require date marking if being cold held longer than 24 hours. Ensure that dressings are date marked to make sure that they are getting used within the seven day timeframe.

5.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
5.comment:
Observed an accumulation of soil residues on the following:
(i) the interior of the soda machine nozzles. CORRECTED: PIC was informed and cleaned the nozzles during the inspection until they were clean to sight and touch.
(ii) inside the ice machine. PIC was informed and instructed to clean and maintain the machine regularly to prevent contamination.
Ensure food-contact surfaces are clean to sight and touch.
